templates.name: Cast-in-place concrete
templates.description: Footings, slabs, walls and equipment pads, following the field guide: submittals, all 25 items of Checklist A-1 (formwork and shoring, reinforcement, embedded items, mix and delivery readiness, documentation), the written pre-pour release (Approved to pour / with conditions / Rejected), the during-pour test set and post-pour curing, hot and cold weather. US customary units.

elements.name: rebar-submittals
elements.title: Rebar submittal approved (shop drawings and mill certificates)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: An approved rebar submittal is on hand before the pre-pour inspection is requested: shop drawings (latest revision on site) and material certifications for every bar size and grade delivered, heat numbers matching the bundle tags.
elements.reference: Field guide Ch. 5; ACI 301 Section 3; ASTM A615 / A706
elements.recordRequired: Approved shop drawings (revision noted) and mill certificates

elements.name: formwork-drawings
elements.title: Formwork drawings approved (significant pours)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: For significant pours, approved formwork (and shoring) drawings are on hand and the installed forms will be checked against them. Mark N/A, with the reason, where the specification does not require formwork drawings.
elements.reference: Field guide Ch. 5; ACI 347R; ACI 301 Section 2

elements.name: embeds-submittal
elements.title: Embedded items submittals approved
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Approved submittals are on hand for every anchor, sleeve, conduit and other item to be cast in place, so the installation can be verified against them, the structural drawings and the specification.
elements.reference: Field guide Ch. 5; structural and trade drawings

elements.name: subgrade
elements.title: Subgrade / compacted base accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Subgrade or base is firm, unyielding and free of standing water, frost and loose material; field density at or above the specified percentage of laboratory maximum dry density. Specified percentage: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Geotechnical report; ASTM D1557 or D698; ASTM D6938
elements.recordRequired: Field density test report covering this footprint

elements.name: form-dimensions
elements.title: Form dimensions match structural drawings (length, width, depth)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Formed length, width and depth (and line, level and plumb) match the structural drawings within the tolerances in the contract documents. Tolerances: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 1; structural drawings; ACI 117
elements.recordRequired: Tape / survey check of key dimensions and top-of-concrete elevations

elements.name: form-clean
elements.title: Form surfaces clean, free of debris, snow, or standing water
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Inside of every form is clean: no debris, no standing water, no snow or ice. Form joints are tight — a gap of more than 1/16 inch lets paste bleed out and may mean inadequate form bearing.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 2; field guide Ch. 5
elements.recordRequired: Walk-down note; photo of any area cleaned

elements.name: release-agent
elements.title: Form release agent applied uniformly — no excess pooling
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Where the specification requires it, form release agent is applied uniformly to all contact faces with no pooling and none on the reinforcement or construction-joint surfaces; forms are wet-proofed or oiled for stripping without damage.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 3; field guide Ch. 5

elements.name: construction-joints
elements.title: Construction joints chipped, cleaned, and wetted per specification
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Existing concrete at every construction joint is roughened (chipped) to the specified profile, cleaned of laitance and loose material, and wetted (saturated surface-dry, no standing water) as the specification requires. Profile: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 4; ACI 301 Section 2
elements.recordRequired: Photo of each joint before closing the form

elements.name: chamfers-joints
elements.title: Chamfer strips and construction joint forming in place per drawings
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Chamfer strips, keys, bulkheads and joint formers are installed where the drawings show them, straight, secured and of the size detailed.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 5; structural drawings

elements.name: shoring
elements.title: Shoring / reshoring installed per approved shoring plan
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Shoring and reshoring installed per the approved shoring plan, vertical with no lateral lean, on firm bearing; bracing and kickers sized and attached to deadmen or stable anchor points. A form failure during a pour is a life-safety emergency.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 6; approved shoring plan; ACI 347R
elements.recordRequired: Shoring plan revision checked; photo of bracing

elements.name: rebar-size-spacing
elements.title: Rebar size and spacing match structural drawings
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Bar size and grade marks match the approved shop drawings (bar gauge where uncertain). Bars counted in every row and column of each mat; spacing measured in at least three locations across the element and matching the drawings (e.g. "No. 6 at 12 in on center each way") within the specified tolerance — no "close enough". Spacing tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 7; field guide Ch. 5; ACI 318 Ch. 25
elements.recordRequired: Bar count per row / column; the three spacing measurements; three-shot photo set (context, intermediate, close-up with tape across the mat)

elements.name: concrete-cover
elements.title: Concrete cover achieved at all form surfaces
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Clear cover from the outermost bar to the form face is at least the minimum for the exposure condition at every form surface (3 in where cast against and permanently exposed to earth), measured with a ruler to the form face; chairs, bolsters and spacers rated for the bar load and construction traffic. Required cover for this element and tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 8; field guide Ch. 5; ACI 318 Table 20.5.1.3.1; ACI 117
elements.recordRequired: Smallest cover measured, with its location; photo with the rule in frame

elements.name: lap-splices
elements.title: Lap splice lengths and locations match structural drawings
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every lap splice is at the location shown and at least the length scheduled on the structural drawings for that bar size; splices staggered where the drawings require.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 9; structural drawings; ACI 318 Ch. 25
elements.recordRequired: Laps measured (shortest found); photo with tape

elements.name: rebar-clean
elements.title: Rebar free of mud, excessive scale, coatings, or bond-reducing contamination
elements.acceptanceCriteria: No mud, oil, form release agent or heavy rust scale on any bar. Light surface rust without pitting is acceptable; scale that flakes off when wire-brushed must be cleaned or the bar replaced; mud-coated bars are rejected until cleaned.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 10; field guide Ch. 5
elements.recordRequired: Walk-down note; photo of any bar cleaned or replaced

elements.name: couplers
elements.title: Mechanical couplers are the approved product
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Where mechanical couplers are used they are the product, size and type in the approved submittal and are installed per the manufacturer's instructions. Mark N/A where there are none.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 11; approved coupler submittal

elements.name: dowels-hooks-ties
elements.title: Dowels, hook bends, and tie wires positioned per drawings
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Dowels at the size, spacing and projection shown; hooks bent and oriented as detailed; bars tied so the cage holds its position and cover during placement.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 12; structural drawings

elements.name: anchor-bolt-templates
elements.title: Anchor bolt templates positioned and braced per approved shop drawings
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every anchor-bolt group is set with a template (plywood or from the base-plate layout drawing), positioned and braced per the approved shop drawings; pattern and position within the tolerance on the drawings. Tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 13; field guide Ch. 5; anchor-bolt setting plan

elements.name: anchor-bolt-projection
elements.title: Anchor bolt projection, thread protection, and template bracing verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Bolt projection and elevation match the setting plan, threads are protected from concrete, and template bracing will hold position during placement and vibration. Projection tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 14; anchor-bolt setting plan

elements.name: sleeves-blockouts
elements.title: Sleeves, blockouts, and penetrations secured per drawings
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every sleeve, blockout, construction-joint key and penetration is present, located in position, elevation and orientation per the drawings, secured against movement, and capped or protected from concrete intrusion.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 15; field guide Ch. 5; structural and trade drawings

elements.name: conduit-utilities
elements.title: Conduit and embedded utilities approved and located per drawings
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Embedded conduit and pipe are approved and located per the drawings; they do not displace required rebar; outside diameter is not more than one-third of the slab thickness and items are spaced at least three diameters on center.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 16; field guide Ch. 5; ACI 318 (embedded conduits and pipes)

elements.name: grounding
elements.title: Cast-in grounding
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Grounding conductors and connections that will be cast in are installed, connected to the reinforcement or electrode as detailed, with stub-ups at the locations and lengths shown. Conductor size and connection type: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Photos of connections before they are covered

elements.name: mix-design
elements.title: Approved mix design submittal on file; design strength and admixtures verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The approved mix design is on file for every class of concrete in this placement; design strength (f′c), maximum water-cementitious ratio, admixtures and the expected unit weight are noted for the field tests. Specified values: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 17; ACI 301 Section 4; ACI 318 §26.4
elements.recordRequired: Approved mix submittal with reviewer's stamp and date

elements.name: batch-tickets-plan
elements.title: Plant batch tickets will be obtained and reviewed for each truck
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The supplier and contractor have confirmed that a batch ticket comes with every truck and that the inspector reviews each one (mix ID, volume, batch time, water added) before discharge.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 18; ASTM C94
elements.recordRequired: Name of the person collecting tickets

elements.name: weather-plan
elements.title: Cold / hot weather protection plan in place if ambient conditions require
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Where hot-weather conditions are forecast, or cold weather applies (mean daily air temperature below 40 °F, or expected to fall below 40 °F within 24 hours), the accepted hot- or cold-weather plan is on site and its materials are ready. Mark N/A when neither applies. Hot-weather trigger values: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 19; field guide Ch. 5; ACI 305R; ACI 306R
elements.recordRequired: Accepted plan; forecast for the pour day

elements.name: vibrators
elements.title: Vibrators: minimum one internal vibrator per pour crew, backup on site
elements.acceptanceCriteria: At least one working internal vibrator per placing crew, sized for the element, plus a working backup on site before the first truck is discharged.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 20; ACI 309R

elements.name: curing-materials
elements.title: Curing materials on site before pour begins
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The curing materials for the method in the plan (burlap, polyethylene, curing compound, blankets) are on site in sufficient quantity before placement begins.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 21; ACI 308R

elements.name: test-equipment
elements.title: Cylinder molds, slump cone, tamping rod, and thermometer present
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Testing equipment for the full test set is on site: cylinder molds, slump cone and tamping rod, air meter, unit-weight measure, a calibrated thermometer, and an insulated cylinder curing box when weather requires.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 22; field guide Ch. 5; ASTM C31 / C143 / C231 / C138 / C1064

elements.name: pre-pour-form
elements.title: Pre-pour inspection form completed and signed before concrete ordered
elements.acceptanceCriteria: This pre-pour checklist is complete — every item explicitly addressed, N/A recorded where not applicable, no blanks — and signed before concrete is ordered. Findings that must be corrected are issued in writing to the superintendent and re-inspected.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 23; field guide Ch. 5 and Appendix A
elements.recordRequired: Completed checklist; written list of corrections, if any

elements.name: eor-notified
elements.title: Engineer of record notified and approval to proceed confirmed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The engineer of record has been notified that the pre-pour inspection is complete (and was present where the specification requires) and approval to proceed is confirmed in writing.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 item 24; field guide Ch. 5; project specifications
elements.recordRequired: Notification and the engineer's written reply

elements.name: stop-plan
elements.title: Contingency plan for emergency stop of pour known to crew
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The crew knows how the pour is stopped and who calls it (excess slump, form failure, equipment breakdown) and where a construction joint would be made.
elements.recordRequired: Name of the person who briefed the crew

elements.name: pre-pour-release
elements.title: Pre-pour release (in writing)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Written result of the pre-pour inspection: Approved to pour, Approved with conditions (each condition listed), or Rejected. No verbal approval: concrete may not be placed until this release is signed. Concrete placed before release is rejected in its entirety.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-1 result; field guide Ch. 5
elements.recordRequired: Signed release with conditions or deficiencies listed

elements.name: batch-tickets
elements.title: Batch tickets reviewed (including water added)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every truck's ticket shows mix ID, volume, batch time and any water added on site; water added does not take the mix past its maximum w/cm. A load over the maximum slump is rejected and returned — never blended with another load.
elements.reference: Field guide Ch. 5; ASTM C94; ACI 301
elements.recordRequired: Batch tickets for the placement; rejected loads noted

elements.name: test-frequency
elements.title: Test sets taken at the specified frequency
elements.acceptanceCriteria: A test set (slump, air, unit weight, temperature and cylinders) is taken at the frequency in the specification, including the first truck, from samples taken per ASTM C172. Frequency: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Ch. 5; ASTM C172; ACI 318 §26.12
elements.recordRequired: Truck and ticket number for each set

elements.name: slump
elements.title: Slump (ASTM C143)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Slump within the range on the approved mix design: above the maximum means excess water — the load is rejected; below the minimum may not consolidate. Range: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Field test report (time, truck and ticket number); slump-cone photo with rule in frame

elements.name: air-content
elements.title: Air content (ASTM C231)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Air content (pressure meter) within the range specified for the exposure class; recheck in hot weather, when admixtures can change air between plant and site. Range: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: unit-weight
elements.title: Unit weight (ASTM C138)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Unit weight compared with the value expected from the approved mix design; markedly lower suggests excess air, markedly higher too little air entrainment. Expected value and band: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: concrete-temperature
elements.title: Concrete temperature (ASTM C1064)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Measured with a calibrated thermometer within 5 minutes of obtaining the sample. Not above the maximum placing temperature in the specification, and not below the ACI 306 minimum for the section size in cold weather. Limits: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Ch. 5; ASTM C1064; ACI 305R; ACI 306R
elements.recordRequired: Field test report with air temperature

elements.name: cylinders
elements.title: Cylinders cast (ASTM C31) — four per set, labelled
elements.acceptanceCriteria: At least four strength cylinders per test set, molded per ASTM C31 for the mold size, capped, and labelled with date, pour location, truck number and test-set number; test ages per the specification (7-day indicative, 28-day the compliance test). Test ages: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Ch. 5; ASTM C31; ACI 318 §26.12

elements.name: cylinder-curing
elements.title: Cylinder initial curing between 60 °F and 80 °F
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Cylinders left undisturbed, covered against moisture loss, at 60–80 °F for initial curing — insulated curing box in winter, shaded insulated storage in summer. The inspector is responsible for these conditions.
elements.recordRequired: Lowest and highest temperature in the curing box

elements.name: placement
elements.title: Placement: drop height, trunks and lifts
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Concrete placed without segregation: pump lines, tremies, chutes or a flexible trunk bring it to the bottom of tall forms and are raised progressively — no dumping from the top of a wall form. Maximum free-fall height: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Pour start and finish times; truck count

elements.name: consolidation
elements.title: Consolidation by internal vibration
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Vibrator inserted vertically at intervals not over 1.5 times its radius of action, penetrating the previous lift about 6 inches, withdrawn slowly; worked in a pattern, not dipped repeatedly in one spot. No honeycombing or voids when forms are stripped.

elements.name: curing-start
elements.title: Curing applied immediately after finishing
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The curing method in the plan (wet burlap and polyethylene, curing compound, blankets, ponding) is applied to horizontal surfaces within 30 minutes of finishing; curing compound not used where a bonded overlay or coating follows.

elements.name: curing-duration
elements.title: Curing duration
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Concrete kept moist and above 50 °F for the curing period: at least 7 days for Type I / II cement above 50 °F ambient, longer where the specification requires for durability (chemical containment, freeze-thaw exposure). Required period: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: hot-weather
elements.title: Hot-weather measures (if applicable)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: When hot-weather conditions apply, the measures in the accepted plan are in use: cooled mix water or ice, retarders, covered trucks, early or late pour times, windbreaks, sunshades or fog misting. Mark N/A when hot weather does not apply.

elements.name: cold-weather
elements.title: Cold-weather protection and temperature log (if applicable)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: When cold weather applies, the concrete is kept at or above 50 °F in the forms for the protection period and never allowed to freeze before reaching about 500 psi; embedded temperature probes are read at regular intervals and logged. Protection period and reading interval: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: stripping
elements.title: Form stripping
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Forms and shoring removed no earlier than the time or strength stated for the element; stripped surfaces checked for honeycombing, cracks and tie holes, and defects reported. Stripping time / strength: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: anchor-bolt-survey-after
elements.title: Post-pour anchor-bolt survey
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Anchor bolts surveyed after the pour are within the setting-plan tolerances for position, projection and plumb; out-of-tolerance bolts are reported for engineering disposition. Tolerances: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: strength-results
elements.title: 7- and 28-day strength results
elements.acceptanceCriteria: 28-day acceptance per ACI 318 §26.12: every average of three consecutive strength tests is at least f′c, and no single test falls below f′c by more than 500 psi (f′c ≤ 5,000 psi) or by more than 0.10 f′c (f′c > 5,000 psi). 7-day results recorded for trend; low results go to the engineer (cores per ACI 318).
elements.reference: Field guide Ch. 5; ACI 318 §26.12.3; ASTM C39

templates.name: Earthwork and compaction
templates.description: Subgrade proof-roll, fill approval, lift thickness, moisture and field density, grade check and release before building on fill.

elements.name: compaction-criteria
elements.title: Compaction criteria and test method accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The required percentage of maximum dry density, moisture range, lift thickness and test frequency are stated for each fill zone, with the Proctor method named. Values: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: fill-material
elements.title: Fill material approved
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Each borrow source or stockpile has a laboratory moisture-density curve and classification; material meets the specified gradation and plasticity limits and is free of organics, debris and frozen lumps.
elements.reference: ASTM D698 or D1557; ASTM D2487
elements.recordRequired: Laboratory Proctor and classification reports per source

elements.name: proof-roll
elements.title: Subgrade proof-roll
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Exposed subgrade is proof-rolled with the specified loaded equipment; soft, pumping or yielding areas are marked and corrected before fill is placed. Equipment and rutting limit: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.recordRequired: Marked-up plan of soft areas and their correction

elements.name: lift-thickness
elements.title: Loose lift thickness
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Each loose lift is no thicker than the specified maximum for the compaction equipment in use. Maximum: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: moisture
elements.title: Moisture content
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Moisture content at compaction within the specified range of optimum from the moisture-density curve. Range: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: relative-compaction
elements.title: Relative compaction (lowest test)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every field density test is at or above the specified percentage of maximum dry density; failing areas are reworked and retested. Specified percentage: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: ASTM D6938 (nuclear) or D1556 (sand cone); ASTM D698 / D1557

elements.name: test-frequency
elements.title: Test frequency met
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Number of density tests per lift and per area meets the specified frequency. Frequency: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: grade-check
elements.title: Finished grade (largest deviation)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Finished subgrade or fill surface within the specified tolerance of design elevation. Tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: release-to-cover
elements.title: Release before covering or building on fill
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Compaction results, grade survey and corrections are complete and accepted for this area before base, slab or structure is placed on it.

templates.name: Underground conduit / duct bank before backfill
templates.description: Trench and bedding, conduit arrangement, joints, bends, mandrel pull, depth of cover, as-built and release for encasement or backfill. NEC references.

body.title: Underground conduit / duct bank before backfill

elements.name: materials
elements.title: Conduit and fittings submittal accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Conduit type, schedule, fittings, spacers and cement are as accepted and listed for the installation (direct burial or concrete-encased).

elements.name: trench
elements.title: Trench and bedding
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Trench is at the line and depth shown, sides are stable and protected as required, bottom is free of rocks and standing water, and bedding is placed and compacted as detailed.
elements.reference: Electrical site plan; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart P

elements.name: arrangement
elements.title: Conduit count, size and arrangement
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Number, size and position of conduits in each run match the duct-bank section on the drawings, including spares.

elements.name: spacer-interval
elements.title: Spacer interval (largest)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Spacers installed at no more than the specified interval and the conduits held at the detailed separation. Interval: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: joints
elements.title: Joints and couplings
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every joint fully seated and made with the listed method (solvent cement or threaded); couplings staggered where detailed; end bells or bushings at terminations.

elements.name: bends
elements.title: Total bends between pull points (largest run)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: No run has more than 360° of bends between pull points.

elements.name: proof-pull
elements.title: Mandrel / proof pull
elements.acceptanceCriteria: A mandrel or test plug sized for the conduit passes through every conduit; pull string or tape left in each. Mandrel size: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: grounding-conductor
elements.title: Grounding conductor (if specified)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Ground conductor installed along the duct bank where detailed, with connections made as specified. Mark N/A when none is shown.

elements.name: cover-depth
elements.title: Depth of cover (smallest measured)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Cover from finished grade to the top of the conduit or encasement is at least the depth on the drawings and not less than the NEC Table 300.5 minimum for the wiring method and location. Depth: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: encasement-cover
elements.title: Concrete encasement cover (if encased)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Forms or spacers give the detailed concrete cover around the outermost conduits; reinforcement installed where detailed. Cover: Project-specific value required — verify before issue. Mark N/A for direct burial.

elements.name: as-built
elements.title: As-built location recorded
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Run alignment, depth and stub-up locations are surveyed or measured from fixed points and recorded before they are covered.

elements.name: release-to-backfill
elements.title: Release for encasement / backfill
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every earlier line is passed or marked N/A and the run is photographed end to end before encasement or backfill starts. Warning tape is ready to place at the depth shown.
elements.recordRequired: Signed release; photos of the full run

templates.name: Structural steel connections
templates.description: Field guide Checklist A-2: high-strength bolt installation (turn-of-nut, TC and DTI), slip-critical faying surfaces, weld visual inspection, connection geometry, fireproofing readiness and the documentation, ending in a signed acceptance.

elements.name: bolt-grade
elements.title: Bolt grade and diameter match drawing specification
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Bolt grade (ASTM F3125 Grade A325 / F1852 or A490 / F2280 as specified) and diameter match the drawings for every connection; head markings checked.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 1; AISC 360; RCSC Specification
elements.recordRequired: Grade and diameter checked; lot numbers

elements.name: washers
elements.title: Hardened washers under the turned element
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Hardened washers installed under the element turned in tightening (nut or bolt head, per the installation method) and wherever the RCSC Specification requires them.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 2; RCSC Specification

elements.name: holes
elements.title: Bolt holes aligned without drift-pin enlargement
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Holes aligned without evidence of drift-pin enlargement; any reaming was approved and is documented.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 3; RCSC Specification; AISC 360

elements.name: snug
elements.title: All plies in firm contact (snug) before rotation
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every ply is in firm contact — the joint is snug-tight — before any pretensioning rotation is applied.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 4; RCSC Specification

elements.name: turn-of-nut
elements.title: Turn-of-nut rotation per RCSC for bolt length / diameter
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Where turn-of-nut is the method, match-marks show the rotation required by the RCSC Specification for the bolt length / diameter combination. Mark N/A for other methods.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 5; RCSC Specification

elements.name: tc-bolts
elements.title: TC bolts: splined ends confirm pretension; splines removed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Where tension-control bolts are used, every splined end has sheared off, confirming pretension, and all splines are removed from the work area. Mark N/A for other methods.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 6; ASTM F1852 / F2280; RCSC Specification

elements.name: dti
elements.title: DTI washers: feeler-gauge refusal confirms pretension
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Where direct tension indicators are used, the feeler gauge is refused in the number of DTI gaps required by the RCSC Specification / ASTM F959. Gauge and number of gaps: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 7; ASTM F959; RCSC Specification

elements.name: thread-stickout
elements.title: Bolt end at or beyond the nut face after tightening
elements.acceptanceCriteria: After tightening, the end of every bolt is at least flush with the outer face of the nut. Required stick-out: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 8; RCSC Specification

elements.name: faying-mill-scale
elements.title: Faying surfaces free of mill scale (Class B or higher)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: In connections designed for a Class B or higher slip coefficient, faying surfaces are blast-cleaned free of mill scale. Mark N/A where the connection is not slip-critical.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 9; RCSC Specification; AISC 360

elements.name: faying-coatings
elements.title: No paint, oil, or coatings on faying surfaces unless approved
elements.acceptanceCriteria: No paint, oil or other coating on faying surfaces unless it is an approved slip-resistant coating qualified for the required slip class.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 10; RCSC Specification

elements.name: weld-size
elements.title: Weld size matches drawing requirement
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Fillet and groove weld sizes measured with a fillet-weld or bridge-cam gauge meet the drawing requirement along their length.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 11; AWS D1.1
elements.recordRequired: Smallest size measured; photo with gauge

elements.name: weld-cracks
elements.title: No visible cracks in weld or heat-affected zone
elements.acceptanceCriteria: No crack of any size anywhere in the weld or heat-affected zone.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 12; AWS D1.1 visual acceptance criteria
elements.recordRequired: Walk-down note; photo of any defect

elements.name: undercut
elements.title: Undercut within AWS D1.1 acceptance criteria
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Undercut within the AWS D1.1 visual acceptance limits for the weld orientation and primary stress. Limits for this connection type: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 13; AWS D1.1 visual acceptance criteria

elements.name: overlap
elements.title: No overlap (weld metal rolled over toe without fusion)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: No weld metal rolled over the toe without fusion anywhere along the weld.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 14; AWS D1.1

elements.name: porosity
elements.title: Porosity within AWS D1.1 limits for production welds
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Visible piping porosity within the AWS D1.1 visual acceptance limits for the weld type. Limits for this weld type: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 15; AWS D1.1 visual acceptance criteria (table number varies by edition)

elements.name: weld-profile
elements.title: Weld profile meets drawing specification
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Weld profile (flat, convex, concave) and reinforcement meet the drawing and AWS D1.1 profile requirements.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 16; AWS D1.1

elements.name: beam-elevation
elements.title: Beam elevation and bearing verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Beam elevations and bearing lengths match the structural drawings within the erection tolerances in the contract documents. Tolerances: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 17; structural drawings; AISC Code of Standard Practice

elements.name: column-plumb
elements.title: Column plumb within tolerance
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Column out-of-plumb measured and within the erection tolerance in the contract documents (AISC Code of Standard Practice where adopted). Tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 18; AISC Code of Standard Practice

elements.name: shear-tabs
elements.title: Shear tab / clip angle dimensions and position match shop drawing
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Shear tabs and clip angles are the size, thickness and position shown on the approved shop drawings.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 19; approved shop drawings

elements.name: fp-substrate
elements.title: Steel substrate clean, primed, and approved for fireproofing
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Steel to be fireproofed is clean, primed only where the fireproofing system allows it, and approved for application. Mark N/A when fireproofing is not in this inspection stage.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 20; fireproofing manufacturer's instructions

elements.name: fp-protection
elements.title: Application area prepared (masking, shielding)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Masking and shielding protect adjacent work, bolts and faying surfaces from overspray.

elements.name: torque-calibration
elements.title: Torque wrench calibration current
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Calibration of the torque wrench used for inspection sampling is current, and pre-installation verification was done as the RCSC Specification requires. Calibration interval: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 22; RCSC Specification

elements.name: wps-welders
elements.title: WPS and welder qualifications on file for all welders
elements.acceptanceCriteria: A weld procedure specification covers every weld made, and a current qualification is on file for every welder who worked on these connections.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 23; AWS D1.1

elements.name: cwi
elements.title: CWI designation verified for welding inspection
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The person performing welding inspection holds a current CWI (or the qualification the contract names).
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-2 item 24; AWS QC1

elements.name: steel-accepted
elements.title: Connections accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Result of the connection inspection: Accepted (Pass) or Rejected (Fail, deficiencies listed in the note). Every earlier line addressed — N/A recorded where not applicable, no blanks.

templates.name: Piping pressure test (hydrostatic)
templates.description: Field guide Checklist A-3: test package, boundary walkdown, fill and pressurization, hold and examination, post-test and the test certificate. The governing code sets the test pressure and hold time.

elements.name: test-package
elements.title: Hydrotest package reviewed and accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Hydrotest package — boundary drawing, isolation list and test certificate form — reviewed and accepted before the test, stating the test pressure from the governing code (e.g. ASME B31.3: 1.5 × design pressure, temperature-corrected). Test pressure: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-3 item 1; ASME B31.3 §345 (or governing code)

elements.name: boundary-pid
elements.title: Boundary drawing based on latest P&ID revision
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The test boundary drawing is marked up on the latest P&ID revision and reconciled with it.

elements.name: nde-complete
elements.title: Required NDE on welds within boundary complete and accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every examination the code and specification require on welds within the boundary is complete and accepted before the test.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-3 item 3; ASME B31.3 §341 (or governing code)

elements.name: gauges
elements.title: Pressure gauges: at least two, calibration current
elements.acceptanceCriteria: At least two pressure gauges in the circuit, ranged so the test pressure reads in the usable part of the dial, with current calibration. Calibration interval: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: relief
elements.title: Pressure relief device installed and set
elements.acceptanceCriteria: A pressure relief device protects the test system, set no higher than the governing code allows above test pressure. Set pressure: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-3 item 5; ASME B31.3 §345 (or governing code)
elements.recordRequired: Relief device ID and set pressure

elements.name: test-medium
elements.title: Test medium confirmed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Test medium is clean potable water, or the specified alternative (with the specified chloride limit for stainless steel).

elements.name: blinds
elements.title: Every blind on the isolation list installed and tight
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every blind flange on the isolation list is physically verified installed and tight — checked by walking the boundary, not from the list.
elements.recordRequired: Isolation list ticked in the field; photos

elements.name: valves-locked
elements.title: Isolation valves closed and tagged LOCKED CLOSED
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every isolation valve on the list is confirmed closed and tagged LOCKED CLOSED.
elements.recordRequired: Isolation list ticked in the field

elements.name: instruments-isolated
elements.title: Instrument connections isolated or vented
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All instrument connections are isolated or vented as the package requires.

elements.name: sensitive-equipment
elements.title: Sensitive equipment removed or isolated
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Control valves, rupture discs, in-line instruments and other equipment that must not see test pressure are removed or isolated.

elements.name: vents-open
elements.title: High-point vents open for air bleeding
elements.acceptanceCriteria: High-point vents are open so air can be bled during fill.

elements.name: system-condition
elements.title: System free of damage, unsupported spans, or uncompleted work
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The system within the boundary is visually free of damage, unsupported spans and uncompleted work; supports able to carry the water weight.

elements.name: filled-vented
elements.title: System filled completely; all air vented
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The system is filled completely and all air is vented before test pressure is applied.

elements.name: rate-controlled
elements.title: Pressurization rate controlled — no surges
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Pressure is raised in a controlled way with no sudden surges, in steps where the procedure requires.

elements.name: stabilization
elements.title: Stabilization period observed before hold time
elements.acceptanceCriteria: A stabilization period is observed at test pressure before the hold time starts. Period: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: test-pressure
elements.title: Test pressure recorded and compared to specified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Test pressure read at the gauge is at least the specified test pressure and does not exceed the code limit for the system. Test pressure: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-3 item 16; ASME B31.3 §345 (or governing code)

elements.name: hold-time
elements.title: Test pressure held for the required duration
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Pressure held for at least the time the governing code and specification require (ASME B31.3: at least 10 minutes), whichever is longer. Required duration: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-3 item 17; ASME B31.3 §345.4 (or governing code)

elements.name: joint-walkdown
elements.title: Full visual walkdown of all joints during hold
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every joint, valve and fitting in the boundary is examined during the hold period.

elements.name: readings
elements.title: Gauge readings at start and end of hold
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Gauge readings recorded at the beginning and end of the hold period, with time and ambient temperature.

elements.name: pressure-drop
elements.title: No pressure drop beyond the specification allowance
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Any pressure drop during the hold is within the specification allowance and explained by temperature change. Allowance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: no-leaks
elements.title: No visible leakage at any joint, fitting, or seal face
elements.acceptanceCriteria: No visible leakage anywhere in the boundary — joints, fittings, seal faces.
elements.recordRequired: Walk-down note; photos of any leak

elements.name: depressurize
elements.title: System depressurized in controlled manner
elements.acceptanceCriteria: System depressurized in a controlled manner through the designated vent.

elements.name: drained
elements.title: System drained completely, low points and instrument legs
elements.acceptanceCriteria: System drained completely; all low points and instrument legs confirmed drained.

elements.name: reinstated
elements.title: Temporary blinds, plugs and gauges removed; permanent parts reinstated
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Temporary blinds, test plugs and gauges removed and permanent components reinstated with new gaskets where required.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-3 item 24; ASME PCC-1

elements.name: test-certificate
elements.title: Test certificate completed and signed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Test certificate shows system, boundary drawing reference, test pressure, duration, result, inspector and contractor signatures and date. Result: Pass, or Fail with the failure described in the note.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-3 item 25; field guide Checklist A-3 result

templates.name: Electrical pre-energization
templates.description: Field guide Checklist A-4: physical installation, grounding and bonding, insulation-resistance (megger) testing, panels and breakers, protective devices and the authorization to energize.

elements.name: mounting
elements.title: Equipment mounting level, plumb, and secured
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Equipment is level, plumb and secured per the installation drawing and manufacturer's anchorage details.

elements.name: xp-threads
elements.title: Five full threads engaged at explosion-proof fittings (Class I)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every threaded conduit entry into explosion-proof equipment in Class I locations has at least five full threads engaged.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 2; NFPA 70 (NEC) 500.8

elements.name: seals
elements.title: Conduit seals filled and sealed; no voids
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Conduit seals are installed where required, packed and filled with no voids.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 3; NFPA 70 (NEC) 501.15

elements.name: knockouts
elements.title: Unused knockouts plugged or sealed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every unused conduit knockout is plugged or sealed with a listed fitting.

elements.name: conductors
elements.title: Conductors correct size, color-coded, labelled both ends
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Conductors are the size on the cable schedule, color-coded and labelled at both ends.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 5; cable schedule

elements.name: terminations
elements.title: Terminations torqued per manufacturer
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All terminations torqued to the manufacturer's values with a calibrated torque wrench, and marked.

elements.name: insulation-intact
elements.title: No exposed conductors; insulation intact
elements.acceptanceCriteria: No exposed conductor anywhere; all insulation intact.

elements.name: tray-fill
elements.title: Cable tray fill within NEC allowance; no sharp edges
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Cable tray fill within the NEC allowance; no conductor resting on a sharp edge.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 8; NFPA 70 (NEC) Article 392

elements.name: egc
elements.title: Equipment grounding conductor at all enclosures
elements.acceptanceCriteria: An equipment grounding conductor is installed and terminated at every enclosure.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 9; NFPA 70 (NEC) Article 250

elements.name: ground-bus
elements.title: Ground bus connections tight; no double termination
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Ground bus connections are tight with no loose or double-terminated conductors.

elements.name: bonding-jumpers
elements.title: Bonding jumpers at expansion joints and isolation points
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Conduit and cable-tray bonding jumpers installed at every expansion joint and isolation point.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 11; NFPA 70 (NEC) Article 250

elements.name: ground-rods
elements.title: Ground rod connections complete; records on file
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Ground rod connections are complete and the installation (and any resistance test) records are on file. Resistance limit: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: megger-complete
elements.title: Megger testing completed on all power conductors in scope
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Insulation-resistance testing complete on every power conductor in scope.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 13; NETA ATS

elements.name: megger-voltage
elements.title: Circuits tested at the appropriate test voltage
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Each circuit tested at the DC test voltage for its rating in the specification / NETA ATS table. Test voltages: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 14; NETA ATS

elements.name: megger-results
elements.title: Results exceed the minimum
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every conductor exceeds the minimum insulation resistance in the specification; lowest value recorded. Minimum: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 15; NETA ATS

elements.name: megger-failures
elements.title: Failed conductors investigated and repaired
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Any failed conductor investigated, root cause identified, repair documented and retested. Mark N/A when none failed.

elements.name: panel-schedule
elements.title: Panel and breaker schedule matches installation
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The panel / breaker schedule matches the installed configuration.

elements.name: breaker-ratings
elements.title: Breakers sized and rated per schedule
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every breaker's size, rating and interrupting rating match the panel schedule.

elements.name: arc-flash-labels
elements.title: Arc flash labels affixed per completed analysis
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Arc flash hazard labels from the completed arc flash analysis are affixed to every panel.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 19; NFPA 70E; NFPA 70 (NEC) 110.16

elements.name: directory
elements.title: Panel directory complete and legible
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Panel directory complete and legible, identifying every circuit by its specific purpose.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 20; NFPA 70 (NEC) 408.4

elements.name: fillers
elements.title: No open breaker positions or wiring spaces
elements.acceptanceCriteria: No open breaker position without a filler blank; no open wiring spaces.

elements.name: relay-settings
elements.title: Relay settings programmed per coordination study
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Relay settings programmed per the approved coordination study.

elements.name: relay-tests
elements.title: Relay functional test records on file
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Functional test records on file for every protection relay.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 23; NETA ATS

elements.name: ocpd-settings
elements.title: Overcurrent device settings confirmed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Overcurrent device settings confirmed against the approved settings schedule.

elements.name: checklist-signed
elements.title: Pre-energization checklist signed by contractor QC and E&I lead
elements.acceptanceCriteria: This checklist is complete — every item addressed, no blanks — and signed by the electrical contractor's QC and the E&I lead.

elements.name: megger-accepted
elements.title: Megger test records attached and accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Megger records for every circuit in scope are attached and accepted.

elements.name: relay-confirmation
elements.title: Relay setting confirmation signed by engineer
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The engineer has signed the relay-setting confirmation.

elements.name: authorize-energize
elements.title: Authorization to energize
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Result: Authorized to energize (Pass), or Deficiencies — do not energize (Fail, deficiencies listed in the note). Signed by the owner's electrical engineer.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-4 item 28; field guide Checklist A-4 result

templates.name: Instrument calibration
templates.description: Field guide Checklist A-5, one per tagged instrument: pre-calibration checks, five-point as-found check, adjustment, as-left, loop and setpoint verification, and the calibration certificate.

elements.name: tag-match
elements.title: Tag number matches P&ID and instrument index
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The instrument tag matches the P&ID and the instrument index.

elements.name: datasheet-match
elements.title: Make, model, and range match approved datasheet
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Make, model and calibrated range match the approved datasheet.

elements.name: cal-equipment
elements.title: Calibration equipment NIST-traceable; certificates current
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Test equipment is traceable to NIST with current calibration certificates on file.
elements.recordRequired: Test equipment IDs and certificate dates

elements.name: isolated
elements.title: Instrument isolated from process
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Instrument isolated from the process (block valves closed, equalized where applicable).

elements.name: manifold-cal
elements.title: Manifold in calibration position (DP instruments)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: For differential-pressure instruments, the manifold is in the calibration position. Mark N/A otherwise.

elements.name: five-points
elements.title: Five test points across the span (0, 25, 50, 75, 100 %)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: At least five test points applied across the calibrated span: 0 %, 25 %, 50 %, 75 % and 100 %.

elements.name: as-found-readings
elements.title: As-found reading recorded at each point
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The as-found reading is recorded at every test point.

elements.name: as-found-error
elements.title: As-found error compared with tolerance
elements.acceptanceCriteria: As-found error calculated at each point and compared with the specified tolerance; largest error recorded. Tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: as-found-reject
elements.title: As-found out of tolerance documented
elements.acceptanceCriteria: If as-found error exceeds tolerance, it is documented on the calibration record (and rejected where required). Mark N/A when within tolerance.

elements.name: zero
elements.title: Zero adjusted if required; points re-applied
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Zero adjusted where required and the test points re-applied after adjustment.

elements.name: span
elements.title: Span adjusted if required; five-point check repeated
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Span adjusted where required and the full five-point check repeated after adjustment.

elements.name: as-left
elements.title: As-left error within tolerance at all five points
elements.acceptanceCriteria: As-left error within the specification tolerance at all five points; largest error recorded. Tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: loop-signal
elements.title: Loop energized; signal confirmed at DCS / PLC
elements.acceptanceCriteria: With the loop energized, the signal reads at the DCS / PLC in the correct engineering units.

elements.name: alarms
elements.title: High and low alarm setpoints verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: High and low alarm setpoints verified against the cause-and-effect document.

elements.name: trips
elements.title: High-high / low-low shutdown setpoints verified (SIF)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: High-high and low-low shutdown setpoints verified for safety instrumented functions. Mark N/A when the instrument has none.
elements.reference: Field guide Checklist A-5 item 15; IEC 61511

elements.name: vented-restored
elements.title: Instrument vented, manifold to service position
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Instrument vented and the manifold restored to the service position.

elements.name: back-in-service
elements.title: Process isolation restored; back in service
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Process isolation restored and the instrument placed back in service.

elements.name: certificate
elements.title: Calibration certificate completed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Certificate shows tag, instrument type, calibration date, next due date, tolerance, as-found, as-left, pass / fail, performed by and certificate number.

elements.name: filed
elements.title: Certificate scanned and filed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Certificate scanned and filed in the calibration records system.

elements.name: database
elements.title: Calibration database updated with next due date
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Instrument tag and loop number updated in the calibration database with the next due date.

templates.name: Pre-commissioning readiness (per system)
templates.description: Commissioning guide Checklist A-1: the 25 prerequisites to confirm before any commissioning activity on a system, ending in the commissioning manager's authorization to start cold commissioning.

elements.name: mc-certificate
elements.title: Mechanical completion certificate issued
elements.acceptanceCriteria: MC certificate signed by the construction manager and QC manager; no outstanding A-punch items.

elements.name: a-punch-closed
elements.title: All A-punch items closed; B-punch list documented
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Zero open A-items confirmed; B-list reviewed and accepted by the commissioning manager as non-blocking.

elements.name: turnover-package
elements.title: Turnover package received and reviewed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Package contains every document on the turnover index, with red-line markups included.

elements.name: pids-verified
elements.title: P&IDs verified against field installation
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Walk-down confirms piping routing, valve locations, instrument locations and equipment orientation match the latest-revision P&IDs.

elements.name: electrical-drawings
elements.title: Electrical drawings verified against field installation
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Single-line diagrams, cable schedules and termination drawings match as-installed conditions.

elements.name: instrument-datasheets
elements.title: Instrument data sheets available for all instruments
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Current-revision data sheets on file; calibration ranges confirmed against process requirements.

elements.name: loop-diagrams
elements.title: Loop diagrams available for all control loops
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Current-revision loop diagrams on file; signal types, ranges and failure modes documented.

elements.name: vendor-manuals
elements.title: Vendor O&M manuals received for all major equipment
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Manuals on file for every tagged equipment item; startup / commissioning sections flagged and reviewed.

elements.name: sops-drafted
elements.title: Operating procedures drafted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Draft SOPs cover normal startup, normal shutdown, emergency shutdown and abnormal conditions.

elements.name: cx-procedures
elements.title: Commissioning procedures approved
elements.acceptanceCriteria: System-specific commissioning procedures reviewed and signed by the commissioning manager and operations representative.

elements.name: pha-closed
elements.title: PHA / HAZOP recommendations resolved
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All PHA / HAZOP action items for this system are closed or formally deferred with management approval.

elements.name: construction-power
elements.title: Construction power available and verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Temporary or permanent supply energized and tested; voltage, phase and grounding confirmed at the MCC or switchgear.

elements.name: utilities
elements.title: Construction utilities available (air, water, nitrogen)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Utility supplies tested and confirmed at the flow rates and pressures commissioning needs.

elements.name: dcs-communicating
elements.title: DCS / PLC powered and communicating
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Control system powered, I/O modules communicating, system configuration loaded and verified.

elements.name: loto
elements.title: LOTO procedures established and personnel trained
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Commissioning-phase LOTO procedure in place; every commissioning team member trained and verified.

elements.name: ptw
elements.title: Permit-to-work system operational
elements.acceptanceCriteria: PTW active for the commissioning area; issuing authority designated; forms available.

elements.name: boundaries
elements.title: System boundaries and isolation points identified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Physical boundaries documented on marked-up P&IDs; isolation valves and blinds identified and tagged.

elements.name: exclusion-zones
elements.title: Exclusion zones for first energization
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Barricades, signage and restricted-access controls in place for first-energization areas.

elements.name: team-briefed
elements.title: Commissioning team mobilized and briefed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All discipline leads on site; kick-off held; communication protocols set; contact list distributed.

elements.name: operator-training
elements.title: Operator training started or scheduled
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Operations personnel assigned; training schedule issued covering system procedures and emergency response.

elements.name: safety-equipment
elements.title: Safety equipment staged
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Fire extinguishers, spill kits, first aid, gas monitors and emergency PPE staged in the commissioning area.

elements.name: communications
elements.title: Communication systems tested
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Radios, PA and emergency notification tested and working in the commissioning area.

elements.name: env-permits
elements.title: Environmental permits and notifications complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All required environmental permits active; regulatory notifications filed.

elements.name: chemical-plan
elements.title: Chemical management plan in place
elements.acceptanceCriteria: SDS on file for every commissioning chemical; storage, handling and disposal procedures documented.

elements.name: preservation
elements.title: Preservation status verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All preserved equipment inspected; preservation current and adequate; nothing expired.

elements.name: authorize-cold
elements.title: Authorization to commence cold commissioning
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every prerequisite above shows Pass or N/A (with justification). The commissioning manager confirms they are satisfied and authorizes cold commissioning for this system. Every item verified by the responsible discipline lead and countersigned by the commissioning manager; N/A only with a justification. Items that fail go on the punch list as A, B or C.
elements.recordRequired: Signed authorization with date and time

templates.name: Cold commissioning (per system)
templates.description: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2: the 25 cold-commissioning activities (no process fluids) from flushing and hydrotests to motor runs, protection, F&G, ESD and grounding, ending in authorization to proceed to hot commissioning / RFSU review.

elements.name: readiness-complete
elements.title: Pre-commissioning readiness (A-1) complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All 25 readiness items signed off; commissioning manager authorization obtained.

elements.name: flushed
elements.title: Piping flushed or blown per procedure
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Flush water clarity meets the cleanliness standard in the procedure; debris screens inspected and clean; flushing velocity achieved. Cleanliness class and velocity: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: piping-hydro
elements.title: Piping hydrostatic test complete and accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Test held at the code test pressure (ASME B31.3: 1.5 × design, temperature-corrected) for at least the code minimum (B31.3: 10 minutes); no visible leaks. Allowable pressure drop: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2 item 3; ASME B31.3 §345

elements.name: vessel-hydro
elements.title: Vessel / tank hydrostatic test complete and accepted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Tested per ASME Section VIII or API 650 as applicable; certificates signed by the authorized inspector.

elements.name: psvs
elements.title: Pressure relief devices installed and verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: PSVs at the correct locations; set pressures verified against data sheets; tag numbers match the P&ID.

elements.name: instrument-cal
elements.title: Instrument calibration complete — all loops
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Five-point ascending / descending calibration complete; as-left errors within the data-sheet tolerance. Tolerance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: loop-checks
elements.title: Loop checks complete — all loops
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Field-to-DCS signal verified; reads correctly at the DCS; alarms trigger at setpoints.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2 item 7; IEC 62382

elements.name: cv-stroke
elements.title: Control valve stroke testing complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every control valve stroked full range from the DCS; fail position verified against the data sheet; positioner calibrated.

elements.name: onoff-valves
elements.title: On / off valve verification complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every automated on / off valve cycled from the DCS; open / close times recorded; limit-switch feedback confirmed.

elements.name: motor-megger
elements.title: Motor insulation resistance testing complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every motor tested per IEEE 43 at the test voltage for its rating (500 VDC below 1 kV), corrected to 40 °C; results recorded. Minimum insulation resistance: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2 item 10; IEEE 43

elements.name: bump-test
elements.title: Motor bump test / rotation check complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every motor bumped; rotation direction confirmed against the equipment requirement.

elements.name: solo-run
elements.title: Motor solo run test complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Motors run uncoupled; bearing temperatures stable; vibration within ISO 10816 / 20816 limits; no-load current recorded.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2 item 12; ISO 10816 / ISO 20816

elements.name: relay-settings
elements.title: Protection relay settings verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Relay settings match the coordination study; trip values confirmed by secondary injection; test reports on file.

elements.name: cable-megger
elements.title: Cable insulation resistance testing complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All power and control cables tested; insulation resistance meets NETA ATS minimums; results logged.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2 item 14; NETA ATS

elements.name: transformers
elements.title: Transformer testing complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: TTR, polarity, power factor, winding resistance and oil analysis complete and acceptable.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2 item 15; IEEE C57.12; NETA ATS

elements.name: ups-battery
elements.title: UPS / battery systems tested
elements.acceptanceCriteria: UPS load-bank tested; battery discharge test performed; backup duration meets the design.

elements.name: sequence-sim
elements.title: DCS / PLC sequence simulation complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every automated sequence tested in simulation; outputs verified against the control narrative; timing confirmed.

elements.name: alarm-rationalization
elements.title: Alarm rationalization complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Alarms reviewed per ISA 18.2; nuisance alarms suppressed; setpoints confirmed against process requirements.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2 item 18; ISA 18.2

elements.name: fire-gas
elements.title: Fire and gas detection system tested
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every detector bump-tested; alarm and trip functions verified at the fire alarm panel and DCS; cause-and-effect confirmed.

elements.name: suppression
elements.title: Fire suppression systems tested
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Trip, deluge or clean-agent tests complete per the system's NFPA standard and the commissioning plan; systems restored and armed.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2 item 20; NFPA 3; system NFPA standard

elements.name: esd
elements.title: Emergency shutdown (ESD) system tested
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Every SIF loop tested; cause-and-effect matrix fully verified; fail-safe positions confirmed.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2 item 21; IEC 61511

elements.name: grounding
elements.title: Grounding system tested
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Ground resistance within the specified limit; equipment bonding verified; test report on file. Resistance limit: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: alignment
elements.title: Rotating equipment alignment verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Laser alignment within vendor tolerances; alignment report signed.

elements.name: reinstatement
elements.title: Piping reinstatement after testing complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All test blinds removed; permanent gaskets installed; bolting torqued per ASME PCC-1; walked down and signed.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-2 item 24; ASME PCC-1

elements.name: punch-updated
elements.title: Punch list updated
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All new items from cold commissioning on the punch list with priority; no A-items remaining.

elements.name: authorize-hot
elements.title: Cold commissioning complete — proceed to hot commissioning / RFSU review
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All cold-commissioning activities above are complete. The commissioning manager authorizes the system to proceed to hot commissioning / RFSU review. Every item verified by the responsible discipline lead and countersigned by the commissioning manager; N/A only with a justification. Items that fail go on the punch list as A, B or C.
elements.recordRequired: Signed authorization with date and time

templates.name: Hot commissioning (per system)
templates.description: Commissioning guide Checklist A-3: the 25 hot-commissioning activities under permit-to-work, from RFSU and PSSR to loaded runs, the continuous run and environmental monitoring, ending in the commissioning and operations managers' acceptance.

elements.name: cold-complete
elements.title: Cold commissioning (A-2) complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All 25 cold-commissioning items signed off; completion authorization obtained.

elements.name: rfsu-complete
elements.title: RFSU checklist (A-4) complete and signed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All RFSU items verified; RFSU authorization signed by the commissioning manager and operations manager.

elements.name: pssr
elements.title: PSSR complete (where required by PSM)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: PSSR checklist fully executed and signed; findings resolved or formally accepted. Mark N/A, with the reason, where PSM does not apply.

elements.name: sops-final
elements.title: Operating procedures finalized and distributed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Final SOPs issued to operators; emergency procedures posted in the control room and field; operator sign-off on file.

elements.name: operators-trained
elements.title: Operator training complete and verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All assigned operators completed system training; competency verified by examination or demonstration.

elements.name: fluid-procedure
elements.title: Process fluid introduction procedure approved
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Step-by-step introduction procedure approved by operations, commissioning and process engineering.

elements.name: leak-test
elements.title: Leak test at operating conditions
elements.acceptanceCriteria: System pressurized with process fluid or nitrogen to operating pressure; all flanges, connections and seals inspected; zero leaks.

elements.name: thermal-expansion
elements.title: Thermal expansion verified (where applicable)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: At operating temperature, pipe-shoe movement, spring-hanger positions and expansion-joint deflections match the design.

elements.name: feed-quality
elements.title: Process fluid quality confirmed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Feed analyzed and within the process input specification for composition, temperature and contaminants.

elements.name: utilities-full
elements.title: Utility systems at full operating conditions
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Steam, cooling water, instrument air, nitrogen and other utilities at design flows, pressures and temperatures.

elements.name: loaded-run
elements.title: Rotating equipment loaded run complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Pumps, compressors and fans at operating conditions; performance curves verified; vibration within ISO 10816 / 20816 limits.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-3 item 11; ISO 10816 / ISO 20816

elements.name: exchangers
elements.title: Heat exchangers at operating conditions
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Approach temperatures, pressure drops and flows verified against data sheets.

elements.name: loop-tuning
elements.title: Control loops tuned at operating conditions
elements.acceptanceCriteria: PID loops tuned with process fluid; response to setpoint changes and disturbances verified; stable.

elements.name: interlocks-live
elements.title: Process interlocks tested with live process
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Interlocks verified at actual process conditions; trip setpoints and resets confirmed.

elements.name: analyzers
elements.title: Analyzer systems validated
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Online analyzers calibrated with process samples and cross-checked against lab analysis within the specified accuracy.

elements.name: flare-vent
elements.title: Flare / vent systems operational
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Flare lit and stable (or vent open); knockout-drum level controls verified; seal or purge confirmed.

elements.name: waste-systems
elements.title: Waste handling systems operational
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Wastewater, solid waste and emission control systems operating within permit limits.

elements.name: product-spec
elements.title: Product quality on specification
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Product samples meet the specification for every quality parameter; off-spec routing verified.

elements.name: throughput
elements.title: Throughput ramped to design rate
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Rate raised stepwise per the startup plan; design throughput achieved and sustained for the duration the plan requires. Duration: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: continuous-run
elements.title: Continuous operation run complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: System operated continuously at the rate and for the duration the contract requires, with no unplanned shutdowns and all parameters within limits. Duration and rate: Project-specific value required — verify before issue.

elements.name: vibration-baseline
elements.title: Vibration baseline survey complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Baseline vibration survey on all rotating equipment at operating conditions; data stored in the monitoring system.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-3 item 21; ISO 10816 / ISO 20816

elements.name: shift-handovers
elements.title: Shift handover procedures in practice
elements.acceptanceCriteria: At least three shift handovers completed successfully; handover logs reviewed and acceptable.

elements.name: emergency-drill
elements.title: Emergency response drill conducted
elements.acceptanceCriteria: At least one drill (fire, spill or evacuation) with the commissioning / operations crew; deficiencies corrected.

elements.name: env-monitoring
elements.title: Environmental monitoring confirmed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Stack emissions, wastewater discharge and ambient monitoring within permit limits at operating conditions; data logged.

elements.name: ready-performance
elements.title: System accepted for performance testing
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All hot-commissioning items complete; system declared ready for the performance test.

elements.name: accept-performance
elements.title: Hot commissioning complete — accepted for performance testing or handover
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All hot-commissioning activities above are complete; the system is accepted for performance testing or operational handover. Every item verified by the responsible discipline lead and countersigned by the commissioning manager; N/A only with a justification. Items that fail go on the punch list as A, B or C.
elements.recordRequired: Signed by the commissioning manager and operations manager

templates.name: Ready for startup (RFSU)
templates.description: Commissioning guide Checklist A-4: the formal gate between cold commissioning and the introduction of process fluids — 25 items and the RFSU authorization signed by commissioning, operations, safety and process engineering (and construction where SIMOPS apply).

elements.name: cold-complete
elements.title: Cold commissioning complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Checklist A-2 fully signed; cold-commissioning authorization obtained.

elements.name: punch-closed
elements.title: All A-punch and blocking B-punch items closed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Zero outstanding items that affect safety, operability or environmental compliance.

elements.name: pssr
elements.title: PSSR complete (PSM-covered facilities)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: PSSR executed; findings resolved; PSSR authorization signed. Mark N/A, with the reason, where PSM does not apply.

elements.name: sis-validated
elements.title: Safety instrumented systems validated
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All SIFs tested and certified; logic solver in run mode; bypass management in place.
elements.reference: Commissioning guide Checklist A-4 item 4; IEC 61511

elements.name: fire-gas
elements.title: Fire and gas detection operational
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Detectors in service; F&G logic verified; suppression armed; fire alarm panel normal.

elements.name: esd-armed
elements.title: Emergency shutdown system armed
elements.acceptanceCriteria: ESD in run mode; every ESD push button tested; cause-and-effect verified.

elements.name: psvs-in-service
elements.title: Pressure relief devices in service
elements.acceptanceCriteria: All PSVs installed; isolation valves locked open; car seals verified; PSV register updated.

elements.name: electrical-stable
elements.title: Electrical systems energized and stable
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Switchgear, MCCs and panels energized with no alarms; protection armed.

elements.name: dcs-operational
elements.title: DCS / PLC in full operational mode
