elements.acceptanceCriteria: All I/O in scan; control active; historization running; operator displays tested.

elements.name: sops-accessible
elements.title: Operating procedures in place and accessible
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Final SOPs printed, posted and available electronically; emergency procedures at operator stations.

elements.name: operators-verified
elements.title: Operator training verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Training records on file for every assigned operator; competency signed by the operations supervisor.

elements.name: communications
elements.title: Communication systems operational
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Control-room phone, radio, PA and emergency notification tested on the day of RFSU.

elements.name: loto-operations
elements.title: LOTO transitioned to operations protocol
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Construction LOTO tags removed; operations LOTO active; personnel briefed.

elements.name: ptw-active
elements.title: Permit-to-work system active
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Hot work, confined space and line-break permits available; issuing authorities designated; permit boards posted.

elements.name: simops
elements.title: SIMOPS controls in place (if applicable)
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Construction / commissioning boundary defined; physical barriers installed; communication protocols active. Mark N/A where no SIMOPS.

elements.name: fluids-staged
elements.title: Process fluids / hazardous materials staged
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Chemicals, catalysts and process fluids on site; SDS posted; handling and loading procedures reviewed.

elements.name: env-controls
elements.title: Environmental controls operational
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Emission control, wastewater treatment and containment operational and tested; permits active.

elements.name: area-classification
elements.title: Area classification verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Hazardous-area classifications confirmed; electrical equipment in classified areas suitably rated.

elements.name: temporary-removed
elements.title: Temporary facilities removed or secured
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Temporary power, scaffolding, laydown and debris cleared from the operating area.

elements.name: as-builts
elements.title: As-built drawings available
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Red-lined P&IDs, electrical and instrument drawings in the control room reflect the installation.

elements.name: spares
elements.title: Spare parts inventory verified
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Critical startup spares on site; list reviewed by operations and maintenance; storage documented.

elements.name: vendor-reps
elements.title: Vendor representatives scheduled
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Required vendor representatives confirmed on site or on call; contact list distributed.

elements.name: startup-sequence
elements.title: Startup sequence reviewed and approved
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Step-by-step startup procedure reviewed in a team meeting; roles assigned; hold points identified.

elements.name: staffing
elements.title: Night / weekend staffing plan in place
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Shift coverage confirmed for continuous operation; on-call roster distributed.

elements.name: moc
elements.title: Management of change review complete
elements.acceptanceCriteria: Field changes during commissioning documented per MOC; PSI updated; PHA revalidated where required.

elements.name: rfsu-authorization
elements.title: RFSU authorization — introduce process fluids
elements.acceptanceCriteria: The system has been reviewed and is Ready for Startup; authorization is granted to introduce process fluids and start hot commissioning. Where construction continues in adjacent areas (SIMOPS), the construction manager also signs the SIMOPS line. Every item verified by the responsible discipline lead and countersigned by the commissioning manager; N/A only with a justification. Items that fail go on the punch list as A, B or C.
elements.recordRequired: Signatures with printed names and dates
